# Run a Swiss tournament or bracket without the spreadsheet

> Free Swiss pairing generator and bracket maker. Paste your players, get round-by-round Swiss pairings with colour balance, Buchholz and Sonneborn-Berger tiebreaks, or a single or double elimination bracket with byes. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/tournament-pairing-manager/)
- [How to run a Swiss tournament, with a worked example](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/tournament-pairing-manager/how-to-run-a-swiss-tournament.html)
